pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Craft a Storage Terminal and Inventory Connector. Place the connector by compatible storage and connect the terminal following their item instructions. This goal records both placements; the practical crafting lesson follows.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Place an Inventory Connector touching inventories; use Trims across gaps. Expose the connected inventories as one storage network.
